answer: My answer to sybils is Pension contribution history with scheme administrator records — contributions paid into one pension scheme for years — which makes the jetty of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because contributions paid into one pension scheme for years is something they already have; the opal falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the voyage of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
